confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from a single web search of cost-of-living sources. Expatica (Numbeo data, June 2026) and Expat Arrivals (January 2026) reported cappuccino at about THB 80–100, local draught beer at about THB 65–103, an inexpensive meal at about THB 95–125 and a mid-range three-course meal for two at about THB 1,100–1,240. I used midpoints and converted at an assumed rate of about 32.5 THB per USD. That rate is my own estimate, not a sourced figure. Cocktail and wine were not searched. They are estimated from general knowledge and from the usual local price relationship to beer: cocktails at roughly 2.5–3x a draught beer, and wine by the glass at about 2–2.5x, because imported wine is heavily taxed in Thailand. These two are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not taken from any booking pages, and could vary by about ±30% by area and season. July is the low/rainy season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bangkok is a major Southeast Asian tourist capital. The estimates are checked against Ho Chi Minh City and Kuala Lumpur price levels, with Bangkok generally a little more expensive than Ho Chi Minh City for drinks and mid-range dining.
